prompts.water: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeating square ground material for a high-quality dark fantasy isometric RPG. Paint a calm, deep petroleum teal marsh water surface viewed exactly straight down, orthographic, covering the entire square edge to edge. Fine organic currents, very subtle broad patches of submerged green silt, scattered delicate small ripples catching cold silver turquoise light. The water is still and glassy, with generous low-contrast quiet space and restrained detail, medium-dark teal (#203e42 to #35575a) rather than black. Beautiful hand-painted realistic PBR game texture, natural irregularity, no directional waves, no white foam, no shore, no objects, no trees, no sky, no horizon, no perspective, no text, no border, no vignette, no central glow, consistent brightness across the whole image. Designed to tile without visible repetition. Output square image.
prompts.moss: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square terrain material for a dark fantasy isometric RPG, viewed exactly straight down orthographic. Ancient damp marsh forest ground, compacted charcoal-brown earth with olive and soft emerald moss islands, decayed leaves, tiny slate pebbles, sparse fine exposed roots and a few shallow moist depressions. Rich tactile organic detail at a restrained scale, weathered and melancholy, enough flat muddy negative space to read walking paths and enemies clearly. High quality realistic hand painted game environment texture. Midtone muted moss olive, slate gray, warm umber earth, very subtle cool light; no bright highlights. Entire square edge to edge, no perspective, no horizon, no sky, no trees, no large rocks, no plants standing upward, no objects, no borders, no text, no vignette, uniform brightness, seamlessly repeatable.
prompts.cypress: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single isolated environment sprite for an isometric dark fantasy action RPG. A magnificent ancient swamp cypress tree with a gnarled split trunk, spreading twisting roots at its base, an irregular windswept crown of sparse dusty sage and olive leaves, long hanging Spanish moss, one bare reaching branch. Three-quarter isometric game camera from above at 30 degrees, complete tree and roots visible, no ground tile, on a genuinely transparent background with real alpha. Elegant silhouette with visible openings in foliage, realistic hand-painted late-90s dark fantasy art rendered with modern texture detail. Cool misty moonlight on the top left, warm charcoal-brown bark, desaturated sage foliage. Tree is about 4 humans tall, roots modest in footprint. Centered, generous transparent margins, no cut-off branches. No scenic background, no ground patch, no horizon, no text, no drop shadow, no glow, no border. Square image.
prompts.seal: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated ground decal for an isometric dark-fantasy RPG boss arena. A large ancient circular monastic stone floor inlay viewed from a fixed isometric game camera, 30 degree downward angle so the circle appears as an ellipse with exactly 2:1 width to height. An elaborate carved concentric ring of weathered pale slate, Celtic-like interwoven carvings and twelve worn stone radial markers, with a quiet dark desaturated teal slate center large enough for a fight. Fractures, fine moss in the joints, some missing outer stone wedges, uneven softened edge, elegant medieval funerary ornament. The inlay is completely flat, no pedestal, no thick sides, no upright objects, no glowing symbols, no text or lettering. High quality realistic painted game asset with excellent readable stonework. Entire complete ellipse centered with generous empty margin on a truly transparent alpha background, no ground outside ring, no drop shadow, no perspective convergence. Cool gray stone and old moss, gentle overhead light, width fills the square image while height is half the width.
